mapper.update: UPDATE plat_tenant_app SET status = 'DISABLED' WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND installed_revision IS NOT NULL AND deleted = 0
UPDATE iam_api_resource SET status = 'DISABLED' WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND LEFT(resource_code, CHAR_LENGTH(#{prefix})) = #{prefix} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_api_resource (tenant_id, resource_code, resource_name, http_method, url_pattern) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{permission}, #{endpoint.name}, #{endpoint.method}, #{endpoint.path}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 'ENABLED', http_method = #{endpoint.method}, url_pattern = #{endpoint.path}, resource_name = #{endpoint.name}
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_api_resource SET status = 'DISABLED' WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND resource_code = #{permission} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE iam_menu SET status = 'DISABLED' WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND menu_code = #{menuCode} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_menu (tenant_id, app_code, menu_code, menu_name, route_path, component_path, permission_code, status) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{appCode}, #{menuCode}, #{name}, CONCAT('/apps/', #{appCode}), #{component}, CONCAT('biz_', #{appCode}, ':query'), 'ENABLED') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE menu_name = #{name}, component_path = #{component}, app_code = #{appCode}, status = 'ENABLED'
mapper.sql: r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 'ENABLED' AND (r.role_code = 'TENANT_ADMIN' OR (r.is_system = 1 AND r.data_scope_type = 'ALL' AND r.role_code IN ('platform_super_admin',CONCAT(#{tenantCode},'_super_admin'))))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_role_menu (tenant_id,role_id,menu_id,created_by,updated_by) SELECT r.tenant_id,r.id,m.id,#{actor},#{actor} FROM iam_role r JOIN iam_menu m ON m.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND m.menu_code=CONCAT('ext_',#{code}) AND m.deleted=0 WHERE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM iam_role_menu g WHERE g.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND g.role_id=r.id AND g.menu_id=m.id AND g.deleted=0)

INSERT INTO iam_role_api (tenant_id,role_id,api_resource_id,created_by,updated_by) SELECT r.tenant_id,r.id,a.id,#{actor},#{actor} FROM iam_role r JOIN iam_api_resource a ON a.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND a.status='ENABLED' AND a.deleted=0 AND LEFT(a.resource_code,CHAR_LENGTH(CONCAT('biz_',#{code},':')))=CONCAT('biz_',#{code},':') WHERE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM iam_role_api g WHERE g.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND g.role_id=r.id AND g.api_resource_id=a.id AND g.deleted=0)
